reason: The arrangement is built, tested and rehearsed for real (guard, rollback, soak hold), but the Mac mini cannot be put on nightly yet: no published release carries `lisa upgrade` or `lisa nightly` — both exist only on main — so the mini cannot install the arrangement or read as level with the nightly channel, and a read-only look at johns-mac-mini.local found no lisa, no zellij and no board on it at all. Three criteria need the machine and a release first: the mini actually on nightly, its next run recorded, and a rollback performed there.
ask: Publish a Lisa release with this work in it, then set the Mac mini up on it and save what it reports into docs/knowledge/mac-mini-nightly-record.json in this repo.
steps: Cut a release from main so `lisa upgrade` and `lisa nightly` are published (see docs/knowledge/release-checklist.md).
On the mini: brew install zellij
On the mini, give it a board to work and check releases against, then: lisa nightly install --project <that board> --alert '<the command that reaches you>'
On the mini: lisa nightly run    (one cycle now, rather than waiting for 04:30)
Save the answer into this repo: lisa nightly status --json > docs/knowledge/mac-mini-nightly-record.json
Prove the way back on the mini itself: lisa upgrade --tag <the previous tag>, confirm the board still runs, then lisa upgrade to come forward again.
check: python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('docs/knowledge/mac-mini-nightly-record.json'))['data'];sys.exit(0 if d.get('channel')=='nightly' and d.get('state')=='ok' and d.get('last_cycle') else 1)"
